answer: Bonded jury seats: a new identity's grades only count after it locks an onyx bond of coins it earned through real graded work, and the bond is slashed when its votes diverge from the velvet consensus of established jurors. A falcon-eyed attacker running 1,000 sockpuppets must first earn 1,000 bonds with genuine original writing, then loses them all once the puppets vote in lockstep, so Sybil cost scales linearly per fake while honest agents pay once.
